parent_channels.name: Form, Uprightness, and Reversal

subchannels.name: Measured Human Formation
subchannels.scene_or_process: A human form is measured, created, completed, beautified, and set in rectitude.
subchannels.active_motifs: measured design `خ ل ق:B001/m01`, creative bringing-forth `خ ل ق:B002/m01`, completed visible form `خ ل ق:B003/m01`, human creature `ء ن س:B001/m01`, desirable beauty `ح س ن:B001/m01`, broad robust body `ب ل د:B008/m01`, rectitude and evenness `ق و م:B008/m01`, upright stature `ق و م:B011/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Measurement precedes creation, creation resolves into a perceptible human figure, and beauty coincides with straightness and proportion. Broad bodily robustness and upright stature make the well-set form visible as both balanced outline and sustaining build.

subchannels.name: Standing Support and Downward Return
subchannels.scene_or_process: An upright body or structure is sustained, returned from its established state, and directed into a lower position.
subchannels.active_motifs: bodily standing `ق و م:B002/m01`, structural support `ق و م:B009/m01`, return to a former state `ر د د:B001/m01`, directed descent `س ف ل:B004/m01`, lower position `س ف ل:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Standing supplies the initial stable configuration, while support explains how that configuration persists. Return and downward direction then form a single reversal process in which what stood is placed back into a lower state.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A measured form is brought into visible integrity, held upright, and remains liable to return and lowering.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 95:4 `خلقنا الإنسان في أحسن تقويم` and 95:5 `رددناه أسفل سافلين`
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Human proportion extends into the mechanics of standing, structural support, restoration, and directed descent.

parent_channels.name: Functional Repair and Substitution

subchannels.name: Making and Activating
subchannels.scene_or_process: A thing is manufactured, put into operation, and taken up as an active task.
subchannels.active_motifs: manufacture from material `خ ل ق:B002/m02`, operation and application `ع م ل:B002/m01`, rising to undertake an affair `ق و م:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Manufacture provides the object, application makes it operative, and rising to the affair supplies the active operator. Together they form a compact production-to-use sequence.

subchannels.name: Compatible Replacement and Restoration
subchannels.scene_or_process: One item stands in for another, fits its intended place, and restores the prior arrangement without delay.
subchannels.active_motifs: standing in another's place `ق و م:B007/m01`, replacement by another `غ ي ر:B003/m01`, return to owner or place `ر د د:B001/m02`, functional suitability `ص ل ح:B003/m01`, enactment without delay `ك ذ ب:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Substitution is not mere exchange: the replacement must fit the vacant function and be returned into the operative position. Immediacy closes the mechanism by preventing the restored function from remaining suspended.

subchannels.name: Restraint, Repulsion, and Repair
subchannels.scene_or_process: Harm or corruption is stopped, pushed away, and replaced with a sound condition.
subchannels.active_motifs: restraint against corruption `ح ك م:B001/m01`, repulsion and prevention `ر د د:B002/m01`, repair after فساد `ص ل ح:B001/m02`, corrective substitution `غ ي ر:B003/m02`, repair of equipment `غ ي ر:B001/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Restraint blocks the damaging motion, repulsion removes it from its course, and repair reinstates sound operation. Corrective substitution supplies the practical means by which the harmful state is exchanged for a serviceable one.

subchannels.name: Exact and Beneficial Finish
subchannels.scene_or_process: Work is completed with precision until it is secure, sound, and beneficial.
subchannels.active_motifs: exact workmanship `ح س ن:B002/m02`, secure finishing `ح ك م:B004/m01`, sound integrity `ص ل ح:B001/m01`, beneficial maintenance `غ ي ر:B001/m01`, fracture mended on a bend `ء ج ر:B002/m01`, absence of useful result `ب ع د:B009/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Exact execution leads to a tightly secured and useful result. A fracture that heals crooked and an outcome with no benefit supply the contrary finish, distinguishing mere completion from sound, effective completion.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A defective or absent function is restored by activation, compatible replacement, restraint, or exact repair.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Creation and good action open into a technical scene of operating parts, substituting equivalents, arresting failure, and securing a finished repair.

parent_channels.name: Judgment, Authority, and Truth

subchannels.name: Adjudication and Final Reckoning
subchannels.scene_or_process: A measured case comes before judgment, receives an account, and culminates in the standing of resurrection.
subchannels.active_motifs: adjudication between people `ح ك م:B002/m01`, reckoning and judgment `د ي ن:B002/m01`, resurrection and standing `ق و م:B013/m01`, prior estimation `خ ل ق:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Estimation frames the case, adjudication determines it, and reckoning gives the determination its consequence. Resurrection supplies the terminal scene in which those subject to judgment stand for the final account.

subchannels.name: Delegated Judgment and Credited Testimony
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person is trusted, authorized to decide, and either credited or charged with falsehood.
subchannels.active_motifs: delegated arbitration `ح ك م:B005/m01`, crediting testimony or oath `د ي ن:B007/m01`, assent and belief `ء م ن:B002/m01`, attribution of falsehood `ك ذ ب:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Trust grants standing to a witness or arbiter, delegated judgment gives that standing practical force, and attribution of truth or falsehood determines whether the entrusted word remains authoritative.

subchannels.name: Fabrication and Rejection
subchannels.scene_or_process: A false account is manufactured, exposed, and refused like a defective or counterfeit item.
subchannels.active_motifs: falsehood opposed to truth `ك ذ ب:B001/m01`, fabricated speech `خ ل ق:B007/m01`, rejection of error or counterfeit `ر د د:B003/m01`, discrediting a speaker `ك ذ ب:B002/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Fabrication gives falsehood the shape of a made object, while rejection treats it as something inspected and returned. The social act of discrediting the speaker completes the movement from manufactured claim to refused claim.

subchannels.name: Penetrating and Defective Judgment
subchannels.scene_or_process: Sound discernment penetrates a matter, while weak opinion fails to reach or govern it.
subchannels.active_motifs: right-reaching wisdom `ح ك م:B003/m01`, penetrating counsel `ب ع د:B008/m01`, weak opinion `ل ي س:B007/m01`, desirable goodness `ح س ن:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Penetrating counsel gives judgment depth, wisdom directs it toward the right result, and desirable goodness names its valued outcome. Weak opinion forms the reversal: a mind present to the matter but unable to penetrate it.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Claims, conduct, and obligations are entrusted to an authority that distinguishes truth, assigns judgment, and brings a final account.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Final judgment reaches into arbitration, testimony, counterfeit rejection, fabricated speech, and the contrast between penetrating and weak counsel.

parent_channels.name: Work, Exchange, and Recompense

subchannels.name: Work and Uncut Wage
subchannels.scene_or_process: Deliberate good work earns a wage whose duration is not cut off.
subchannels.active_motifs: intentional work `ع م ل:B001/m01`, wage and recompense `ء ج ر:B001/m01`, worker's pay `ع م ل:B004/m01`, uncut duration `م ن ن:B001/m01`, sound deed `ص ل ح:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Intentional action supplies the labor, soundness qualifies the deed, and wage names the return. The cutting sense of `م ن ن` defines the reward negatively as a payment whose extension is not severed or diminished.

subchannels.name: Debt, Dealing, and Rescission
subchannels.scene_or_process: Parties enter a deferred obligation, transact with one another, settle conflict, and may reclaim or unwind the exchange.
subchannels.active_motifs: debt and credit sale `د ي ن:B003/m01`, interpersonal dealing `ع م ل:B005/m01`, repossession and rescission `ر د د:B004/m01`, negotiated settlement `ص ل ح:B002/m01`, assessed compensation `ح ك م:B002/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Debt creates the continuing obligation, dealing establishes the relation between parties, and settlement governs disagreement within it. Rescission and assessed compensation provide two different closures: reversing the transaction or fixing what one party owes.

subchannels.name: Valuation and Equal Weight
subchannels.scene_or_process: Goods or liabilities are priced, weighed to an even standard, and converted into quantified compensation.
subchannels.active_motifs: pricing and valuation `ق و م:B010/m01`, equal coin weight `ق و م:B015/m01`, measured quantity `م ن ن:B005/m01`, blood-money compensation `غ ي ر:B002/m01`, circulating market demand `ق و م:B018/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Valuation assigns an amount, equal weight stabilizes the unit, and measured quantity makes the amount transferable. Market circulation gives the unit an arena of exchange, while blood money extends quantified substitution from commodities to retaliation.

subchannels.name: Labor, Office, and Livelihood
subchannels.scene_or_process: Workers perform manual or appointed service and receive the means by which life and social order are maintained.
subchannels.active_motifs: appointed public work `ع م ل:B003/m01`, manual workers `ع م ل:B006/m01`, livelihood and subsistence `ق و م:B009/m02`, wage `ء ج ر:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Manual labor and appointed office are two organized forms of service. Wage converts that service into livelihood, while the support sense of `ق و م` makes livelihood what keeps both body and social arrangement standing.

subchannels.name: Bondage, Restitution, and Unransomed Release
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person is held under coercive ownership, then either restored through return or released without a counterpayment.
subchannels.active_motifs: subjugation and enslavement `د ي ن:B004/m01`, release without ransom `م ن ن:B004/m01`, recovery and return `ر د د:B004/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Subjugation establishes control over the person, recovery reverses possession, and gratuitous release ends captivity without equivalent exchange. The scene turns the language of debt and payment into a contrast between priced return and unpriced freedom.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Deliberate labor enters relations of wage, debt, valuation, restitution, livelihood, and release.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 95:6 `عملوا الصالحات فلهم أجر غير ممنون` and 95:7 `الدين`
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The unending reward scene expands into labor markets, credit, pricing, equal weights, rescission, public office, bondage, and release without ransom.

parent_channels.name: Faith, Worship, and Moral Character

subchannels.name: Worship, Obedience, and Upright Disposition
subchannels.scene_or_process: An inward character is oriented into worship, obedience, and straight conduct.
subchannels.active_motifs: worship and the worshipped one `ء ل ه:B001/m01`, obedience and religion `د ي ن:B001/m01`, inward disposition `خ ل ق:B004/m01`, moral straightness `ق و م:B008/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Character supplies the inward formation, religion gives it an order of obedience, and worship directs it toward the divine. Straightness is the shared state in which inner disposition and enacted allegiance coincide.

subchannels.name: Faith, Good Work, and Beneficence
subchannels.scene_or_process: Belief becomes intentional sound action and exceeds bare correctness through beneficence.
subchannels.active_motifs: assent and faith `ء م ن:B002/m01`, intentional action `ع م ل:B001/m01`, rectitude in deed `ص ل ح:B001/m01`, beneficent action `ح س ن:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Faith supplies settled assent, work converts assent into action, and rectitude defines the action as sound. Beneficence carries the process beyond avoidance of فساد into active good done well.

subchannels.name: Apostasy and Religious Return
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person reverses religious allegiance, leaving an upright order for its contrary.
subchannels.active_motifs: apostatic return `ر د د:B005/m01`, religious obedience `د ي ن:B001/m01`, straight alignment `ق و م:B008/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Religious straightness supplies the initial alignment, while apostatic return gives reversal a specific social and doctrinal form. The same root that returns a thing to a prior state can therefore mark a departure from the adopted religious order.

subchannels.name: Benefaction and Reproachful Reminder
subchannels.scene_or_process: A favor creates trust and benefit, but repeated self-credit can burden the recipient and undo the social value of the gift.
subchannels.active_motifs: benefaction `م ن ن:B003/m01`, reproachful recounting `م ن ن:B003/m02`, generous good `ح س ن:B002/m03`, trust and security `ء م ن:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Benefaction establishes a relation of good and security. Recounting the favor shifts the gift from benefit to pressure, producing a moral reversal in which speech after the act can destroy the act's social integrity.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Inner disposition aligns with worship, belief, upright conduct, benefaction, and the possibility of religious return or rupture.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 95:4 `الإنسان في أحسن تقويم`, 95:6 `آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات`, 95:7 `الدين`, and 95:8 `الله`
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Religious alignment is rendered as inward character, straightness, beneficial action, apostasy, divine favor, and the destructive social act of recounting a favor.

parent_channels.name: Landmark, Celestial Station, and Settlement

subchannels.name: Mountain and Named Landmark
subchannels.scene_or_process: Mountains and named places organize a landscape into recognizable sacred or inhabited landmarks.
subchannels.active_motifs: fig-associated mountain place `ت ي ن:B002/m01`, mountain landmark `ط و ر:B005/m01`, bounded tract of land `ب ل د:B001/m01`, named places `ص ل ح:B005/m01`, mountain or elevated body-name `ح س ن:B004/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Mountain, tract, and place-name cooperate as a geography of recognition. The same naming process moves between ordinary terrain and elevated landmarks, allowing a lexical mountain sense of the fig to join the explicit mountain and city sequence.

subchannels.name: Celestial Station and Zenith
subchannels.scene_or_process: The sky is partitioned into a lunar station, a named celestial body, and the balanced instant of solar noon.
subchannels.active_motifs: lunar station and empty sky-place `ب ل د:B004/m01`, moon as a named beautiful body `ح س ن:B004/m02`, sun standing at noon `ق و م:B017/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: A bounded place migrates from earth to sky as a lunar station, while beauty names the visible celestial body. The sun's standing at the midpoint of the day supplies the scene's temporal and geometric balance.

subchannels.name: Residence, City, and Civic Obedience
subchannels.scene_or_process: People remain in a settled place whose identity depends on residence, assembly, and obedience to authority.
subchannels.active_motifs: settled residence `ب ل د:B009/m01`, station and dwelling `ق و م:B006/m01`, city organized by obedience `د ي ن:B006/m01`, remaining without departure `ل ي س:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Residence converts land into an inhabited station, prolonged remaining stabilizes it, and civic obedience gives the settlement an ordered political form. City is therefore both a place occupied and a relation maintained.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A place becomes intelligible through prominent terrain, named stations, residence, and the civic order maintained there.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The named landscape extends from mountains and towns into lunar stations, the noonday balance of the sun, civic obedience, and habitual residence.

parent_channels.name: Boundary, Relative Position, and Separation

subchannels.name: Edge, Enclosure, and Near-Far Relation
subchannels.scene_or_process: A bounded place has an aligned edge, a protected vicinity, an approach zone, and a measurable distance beyond it.
subchannels.active_motifs: aligned edge or frontage `ط و ر:B001/m01`, approach to an enclosure `ط و ر:B002/m01`, terminal boundary `ط و ر:B003/m01`, distance from nearness `ب ع د:B001/m01`, bounded place `ب ل د:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The aligned edge gives a place shape, the enclosure creates an inside and a vicinity, and approach measures movement toward that boundary. Distance names the corresponding movement away from it.

subchannels.name: Facing Side, Forepart, and Posteriority
subchannels.scene_or_process: A body or implement is oriented by the side facing a person, its working forepart, its lower line, and what comes behind.
subchannels.active_motifs: human-facing inner side `ء ن س:B004/m01`, spear forepart `ع م ل:B009/m01`, posterior or subsequent position `ب ع د:B002/m01`, lower line `س ف ل:B001/m01`, leeward side `س ف ل:B003/m01`, aligned edge `ط و ر:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The human-facing side fixes orientation from the participant's viewpoint, while the spear's forepart supplies a functional front. Lower, leeward, and posterior positions complete a directional frame that works across bodies, tools, wind, and sequences.

subchannels.name: Lower Boundary and Outward Separation
subchannels.scene_or_process: A lower or rear boundary marks the point from which something is directed away and placed at a distance.
subchannels.active_motifs: lower bodily outlet `س ف ل:B007/m01`, active distancing `ب ع د:B003/m01`, limit crossed or reached `ط و ر:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The lower outlet provides a concrete boundary, the limit gives it a terminal edge, and active distancing describes motion beyond that edge. The channel is organized by separation from a bounded body rather than by general bodily anatomy.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Entities are located by edges, near and far relations, facing and trailing sides, and movement across a lower or outer boundary.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Spatial language reaches from courtyards and distant places into spear anatomy, the human-facing side of an object, posteriority, and a lower bodily outlet.

parent_channels.name: Human Community, Rank, and Belonging

subchannels.name: Provisioned Human Group
subchannels.scene_or_process: A human group is identified by shared affiliation, manual work, travel, and provision.
subchannels.active_motifs: human collective `ء ن س:B001/m01`, people and men `ق و م:B001/m01`, attributed possessor or kin `ذ و و:B001/m01`, oil as group provision `ز ي ت:B004/m01`, manual workers `ع م ل:B006/m01`, travelers on foot `ع م ل:B012/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Human presence becomes a social group through affiliation and shared labor. Provision sustains the group, while hand-workers and foot-travelers show the collective in two recurrent modes: producing in place and moving together.

subchannels.name: Rank, Aptitude, and Counsel
subchannels.scene_or_process: Social position is evaluated through low rank, practical aptitude, penetrating counsel, and failure of judgment.
subchannels.active_motifs: low social rank `س ف ل:B002/m01`, dullness and lagging capacity `ب ل د:B007/m01`, penetrating counsel `ب ع د:B008/m01`, weak opinion `ل ي س:B007/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Low rank and dull performance mark diminished standing, while penetrating counsel marks valued social capacity. Weak opinion reverses the latter, making hierarchy a relation of perceived usefulness as well as lineage or position.

subchannels.name: Kinship, Return, and Protective Honor
subchannels.scene_or_process: A woman returns to her family, and kinship organizes protection, jealousy, guarded closure, and their dishonorable absence.
subchannels.active_motifs: distant kin `ب ع د:B005/m01`, returned or divorced woman `ر د د:B006/m01`, protective jealousy `غ ي ر:B004/m01`, guarded closure `خ ل ق:B012/m01`, dishonorable lack of jealousy `ل ي س:B008/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Return places the woman back within her family network, where nearness and distance define responsibility. Protective jealousy and guarded closure express defense of that boundary, while the absence of jealousy marks its social inversion.

subchannels.name: Companion, Confidant, and Inner Self
subchannels.scene_or_process: Estrangement is removed by trusted company until the companion becomes an intimate, confidant, or figure for one's own self.
subchannels.active_motifs: companionship that removes estrangement `ء ن س:B003/m01`, intimate or chosen companion `ء ن س:B006/m01`, the self named as deceptive `ك ذ ب:B008/m01`, trust and security `ء م ن:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Companionship first removes isolation, then narrows into the chosen intimate. The lexical self introduces an inward participant whose truthfulness is not guaranteed, so trust becomes the relation that holds intimacy together.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Human beings form provisioned groups structured by possession, labor, rank, kinship, protection, and intimate attachment.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The human collective includes manual workers and travelers, distant kin, low rank, penetrating counsel, protective jealousy, a returned woman, and the inward circle of confidants.

parent_channels.name: Familiarity, Fitness, and Steadfast Capacity

subchannels.name: Familiar Presence Against Wild Absence
subchannels.scene_or_process: Human or tame presence occupies a place from which wildness, estrangement, or complete absence would otherwise withdraw.
subchannels.active_motifs: human presence `ء ن س:B001/m01`, tame familiarity `ء ن س:B003/m01`, wildness beyond human familiarity `ط و ر:B006/m01`, absence of anyone in the place `ط و ر:B007/m01`, wolf named `تينان` `ت ي ن:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Familiarity is spatial and social: a place is humanly occupied, a participant can be approached without hostility, and wildness marks movement beyond that relation. The named wolf supplies a concrete wild participant, while total absence is the limiting case in which no familiar participant remains.

subchannels.name: Suitability and Immediate Readiness
subchannels.scene_or_process: A participant is predisposed to a task, fits its requirements, reaches the limit of effort, and acts without delay.
subchannels.active_motifs: predisposition and worthiness `خ ل ق:B005/m01`, functional suitability `ص ل ح:B003/m01`, utmost effort `ح س ن:B005/m01`, effortful exertion `ع م ل:B007/m01`, action without delay `ك ذ ب:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Predisposition supplies latent capacity, suitability aligns that capacity with a particular use, and exertion realizes it at the limit of effort. Immediacy marks completed readiness by eliminating hesitation between fitness and action.

subchannels.name: Courage and Forbearing Endurance
subchannels.scene_or_process: A participant remains before danger or burden, carries what is imposed, and does not withdraw in fear.
subchannels.active_motifs: warrior who does not leave his opponent `ل ي س:B004/m01`, patient forbearance `ل ي س:B006/m01`, security against fear `ء م ن:B001/m01`, sustaining strength `م ن ن:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Security removes fear, courage fixes the participant in confrontation, and forbearance extends the same steadfastness into social burden. Sustaining strength explains how remaining in place becomes durable rather than momentary.

subchannels.name: Strength, Frailty, and Exhausted Halt
subchannels.scene_or_process: A body, rope, or working animal either possesses the strength to stand and continue or weakens until motion stops.
subchannels.active_motifs: sustaining strength `م ن ن:B002/m01`, frailty of person or material `م ن ن:B002/m02`, bodily stature `ق و م:B011/m01`, stoppage through exhaustion `ق و م:B016/m01`, dull or lagging performance `ب ل د:B007/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Stature supplies the standing frame, strength lets it persist, and frailty reduces its capacity. Lag and exhausted stopping are the observable outcomes when that supporting force fails.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Capacity appears as the ability to approach without fear, fit an intended role, bear a load, and continue rather than lag or stop.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Human familiarity, technical suitability, warrior courage, animal stamina, bodily stature, and material strength become variations of remaining fit for engagement.

parent_channels.name: Deixis, Negation, and Invocation

subchannels.name: Pointing, Reference, and Naming
subchannels.scene_or_process: A speaker calls attention and identifies a referent by demonstrative, relative expression, or proper name.
subchannels.active_motifs: demonstrative `ذا` `ذ و و:B003/m01`, relative `ذو` `ذ و و:B002/m01`, attention-opening `ها` `ه ا ء:B002/m01`, personal proper name `صالح` `ص ل ح:B004/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The attention particle opens a shared field of notice, the demonstrative selects a present item, and relative or proper naming keeps that item identifiable in discourse. `هذا` realizes the compact pointing form on the surface.

subchannels.name: Inquiry, Urging, and Handover
subchannels.scene_or_process: A speaker asks what is at issue, urges an obligation, and places an offered object or command before the addressee.
subchannels.active_motifs: interrogative or relative `ماذا` `ذ و و:B004/m01`, interrogative `ها` `ه ا ء:B004/m01`, urging formula `كذب عليك` `ك ذ ب:B003/m01`, handover command `هاك` `ه ا ء:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Inquiry identifies the unknown item, the urging formula converts it into something incumbent, and handover presents it for uptake. The discourse moves from asking to obligating to giving.

subchannels.name: Negation, Exception, and Absence
subchannels.scene_or_process: A proposition or participant is denied, excluded, or declared absent from a set or place.
subchannels.active_motifs: predicative negation `ل ي س:B001/m01`, exception by `ليس` `ل ي س:B002/m01`, coordinating or absolute negation `ل ي س:B003/m01`, otherness and exception `غ ي ر:B005/m01`, negated-distance idiom `ب ع د:B006/m01`, absence of anyone `ط و ر:B007/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Predicative negation denies a state, exception removes one member from a set, and otherness marks the excluded alternative. Negated distance reverses remoteness into proximity, while the empty-place formula gives negation a spatial result: no participant remains within the domain.

subchannels.name: Divine Address, Amen, and Vocal Response
subchannels.scene_or_process: A divine name is called, a response is voiced, and `amen` asks that the utterance be fulfilled.
subchannels.active_motifs: `amen` as request for response `ء م ن:B003/m01`, divine name in address or oath `ء ل ه:B002/m01`, answer to a caller `ه ا ء:B003/m01`, letter-name and voiced `هاء` `ه ا ء:B006/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Divine address establishes the addressee, the answering voice realizes response, and `amen` turns response into a request for fulfillment. The letter-name preserves the utterance at the level of its sounded and written form.

subchannels.name: Imprecation and Banishment
subchannels.scene_or_process: A divine imprecation verbally drives its target away from good and into ruin.
subchannels.active_motifs: ruin and curse as distance `ب ع د:B004/m01`, divine name in oath or address `ء ل ه:B002/m01`, active distancing `ب ع د:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Divine address supplies the authority of the utterance, active distancing gives the curse its motion, and ruin names the terminal state as exclusion from good.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Small utterance forms organize discourse by pointing, questioning, urging, excluding, negating, calling, and answering.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The demonstrative and negative surface opens into handover formulas, interrogatives, exception, the absence of anyone, divine address, the response to a caller, and the written name of a letter.

parent_channels.name: Fruit, Oil, and Applied Fragrance

subchannels.name: Fig and Olive Produce
subchannels.scene_or_process: Edible fig fruit and the olive tree or fruit appear as paired produce.
subchannels.active_motifs: edible fig fruit `ت ي ن:B001/m01`, olive tree and fruit `ز ي ت:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The two motifs form a direct food-and-cultivation pair: one names the fig as eaten fruit and the other the olive as both tree and fruit.

subchannels.name: Oil, Pressing, Trade, and Provision
subchannels.scene_or_process: Olives yield oil, a specialist presses or sells it, and the product becomes food provision within a group.
subchannels.active_motifs: olive oil and extract `ز ي ت:B001/m01`, oil seller or presser `ز ي ت:B005/m01`, oil as provision `ز ي ت:B004/m01`, commercial dealing `ع م ل:B005/m01`, recipient group `ق و م:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Extraction creates the product, specialized labor moves it into exchange, and provision carries it from seller to community. The oil is therefore simultaneously substance, commodity, and shared food.

subchannels.name: Oiling, Perfuming, and Recurrent Application
subchannels.scene_or_process: Oil or fragrance is spread over a surface and renewed through repeated application.
subchannels.active_motifs: oiling and anointing `ز ي ت:B003/m01`, aromatic coating `خ ل ق:B010/m01`, intermittent recurrence `ب ع د:B007/m01`, trodden path `ع م ل:B011/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Oiling and perfuming share the action of laying a substance onto a surface. Intermittent recurrence renews the coating, while the trodden path extends repeated application into a surface marked and maintained by passage.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Fruit becomes oil and provision, then enters trade and repeated surface application as food, ointment, or fragrance.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 95:1 `التين والزيتون`, with an indirect extension through 95:6 `عملوا` and 95:7 `بعد`
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The paired fruits develop into pressing, selling, communal provision, oiling, perfuming, recurrent application, and the worn continuity of a traveled path.

parent_channels.name: Visible Appearance and Material Surface

subchannels.name: Pupil Image and Sightless Intact Eye
subchannels.scene_or_process: A human image appears in the pupil, while an eye can retain its visible globe after vision has gone.
subchannels.active_motifs: sensory perception by sight, hearing, or feeling `ء ن س:B002/m01`, reflected human in the pupil `ء ن س:B005/m01`, intact but sightless eye `ق و م:B021/m01`, bodily surface mark `ب ل د:B006/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Perception establishes the active sensory function and the pupil gives vision a visible miniature human image. The standing eye reverses that relation by preserving outward form after sight disappears, while the surface mark reinforces the distinction between what a body displays and what it can do.

subchannels.name: Brow, Skin Mark, Beauty, and Facial Defect
subchannels.scene_or_process: The visible face is read through openness between the brows, marks on skin, beauty, and a defect that mixes ugliness with remaining form.
subchannels.active_motifs: clear space between the brows `ب ل د:B003/m01`, mark on skin or body `ب ل د:B006/m01`, facial or chin defect `ر د د:B008/m01`, visible beauty `ح س ن:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Brow spacing and skin marks make the face a legible surface, beauty supplies its positive valuation, and defect complicates that reading by combining impairment with remaining form.

subchannels.name: Worn Cloth and Deceptive Ornament
subchannels.scene_or_process: Cloth loses pile and integrity through wear, yet coloring or ornament can make its visible state misrepresent its actual condition.
subchannels.active_motifs: frayed and worn cloth `خ ل ق:B009/m01`, ornamented cloth that belies its state `ك ذ ب:B009/m01`, material frailty `م ن ن:B002/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Wear reduces the material body of the cloth, frailty names its diminished resistance, and ornament supplies a contrary visual message. Appearance and integrity therefore move in opposite directions.

subchannels.name: Ground Contact, Smoothness, and Sealed Surface
subchannels.scene_or_process: A body lies against the ground, is smoothed into an even surface, and may become solidly closed while bearing sustained contact.
subchannels.active_motifs: camel breast laid on the ground `ب ل د:B002/m02`, adhesion to the ground `ب ل د:B010/m01`, smooth even surface `خ ل ق:B008/m01`, sealed solid closure `خ ل ق:B012/m01`, patient bearing `ل ي س:B006/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The camel's breast and the adhering body establish sustained ground contact, smoothing removes irregularity, and sealed solidity gives the surface resistance. Forbearance carries the same invariant into conduct: remaining under pressure without opening, breaking, or reacting.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A visible surface can display form, mark, polish, defect, decay, or ornament while concealing a different functional state.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Human beauty reaches into pupil reflections, an intact but blind eye, facial marks, worn cloth, deceptive ornament, polished ground contact, and sealed smoothness.

parent_channels.name: Bodily and Mechanical Support

subchannels.name: Lower Limbs and Leg Disease
subchannels.scene_or_process: Lower limbs support an animal or object, perform work, and can be impaired by a disease that forces standing.
subchannels.active_motifs: camel legs `س ف ل:B005/m01`, working limbs `ع م ل:B010/m01`, standing member or leg `ق و م:B012/m01`, disease in an animal's legs `ق و م:B020/m01`, pain established in an organ `ق و م:B019/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Legs are simultaneously lower parts, working organs, and standing supports. Disease and established organ pain reveal the mechanism by disrupting the same members on which posture and motion depend.

subchannels.name: Bridle, Spear Forepart, and Handle
subchannels.scene_or_process: A handler orients and controls an implement or animal through a forepart, human-facing side, grip, and restraining fitting.
subchannels.active_motifs: bridle around the jaws `ح ك م:B006/m01`, spear forepart `ع م ل:B009/m01`, human-facing side `ء ن س:B004/m01`, hilt or handle `ق و م:B012/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: The human-facing side locates the handler, the handle transfers force, and the forepart directs it toward the task. The bridle completes the assembly by converting the handler's force into restraint.

subchannels.name: Prop, Load, Strength, and Collapse
subchannels.scene_or_process: A prop or sustaining frame bears a load until weakness or exhaustion makes the supported body stop or fall.
subchannels.active_motifs: prop preventing collapse `ر د د:B009/m01`, structural support `ق و م:B009/m01`, sustaining strength `م ن ن:B002/m01`, frailty `م ن ن:B002/m02`, load-bearing capacity `ل ي س:B006/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: The prop and standing support resist collapse, sustaining strength carries the imposed load, and load-bearing capacity describes the active bearer. Frailty is the failure mode in which that same assembly can no longer hold.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Bodies and implements remain serviceable through lower members, restraining fittings, handles, props, and load-bearing strength.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Human and animal anatomy assembles with spear shafts, sword hilts, furniture legs, bridles, props, and the strength or weakness of a supporting rope.

parent_channels.name: Animal Work, Milk, and Offspring

subchannels.name: Trained Work Animal and Lagging Failure
subchannels.scene_or_process: An animal bred or habituated for work continues under load, while dullness, weakness, or exhaustion makes it lag and halt.
subchannels.active_motifs: animal formed for work `ع م ل:B008/m01`, lagging animal performance `ب ل د:B007/m02`, exhausted stopping `ق و م:B016/m01`, loss of strength `م ن ن:B002/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Training gives the animal a stable work disposition, strength carries that disposition into motion, and lag exposes reduced aptitude. Exhausted stopping is the terminal state when the work capacity can no longer be sustained.

subchannels.name: Udder Filling and Milk Cessation
subchannels.scene_or_process: Milk gathers in the udder, is expected to continue, and then may disappear before that expectation is fulfilled.
subchannels.active_motifs: udder filling `ر د د:B007/m01`, milk that fails to last `ك ذ ب:B006/m01`, dependable animal `ء م ن:B001/m03`, exhaustion and cessation `م ن ن:B001/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Udder filling establishes stored abundance, dependability frames the expectation of continued yield, and failed duration breaks that expectation. Cessation turns a bodily production scene into a concrete model of reliability and disappointment.

subchannels.name: Nest, Egg, and Young Animals
subchannels.scene_or_process: A ground nest contains an egg while young animals form the dependent lower generation of a herd.
subchannels.active_motifs: ostrich nest and abandoned egg `ب ل د:B012/m01`, young or offspring of camels `س ف ل:B006/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The nest supplies the protective ground setting and the egg its vulnerable occupant. Young camels extend the same relation from enclosed egg to dependent offspring within a mobile herd.

subchannels.name: Run, Halt, and Backward Look
subchannels.scene_or_process: A wild animal runs a stretch, stops, and looks back before motion resumes or ends.
subchannels.active_motifs: wild-animal run followed by a stop `ك ذ ب:B007/m01`, intermittent recurrence `ب ع د:B007/m01`, returning gaze `ر د د:B001/m03`
subchannels.synthesis: The run supplies forward motion, the stop breaks its continuity, and the returning gaze reverses orientation toward the path already crossed. Intermittence captures the repeated alternation between advance and pause.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Animal life is organized through trained labor, bodily continuity, milk production, movement, and the protection of young.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 95:1 `التين`, 95:3 `البلد الأمين`, 95:4 `تقويم`, 95:5 `رددناه أسفل`, 95:6 `عملوا` and `ممنون`, and 95:7 `بعد` and `يكذبك`
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Human-centered roots disclose the trained work animal, the filling udder, milk that fails to last, an ostrich nest, young camels, and a wild animal that runs then stops to look back.

parent_channels.name: Succession, Recurrence, and Cessation

subchannels.name: Stages, Repetition, and Hesitation
subchannels.scene_or_process: A process passes through successive states, but repeated return can turn ordered recurrence into hesitation and confusion.
subchannels.active_motifs: successive stages `ط و ر:B004/m01`, repetition and hesitation `ر د د:B010/m01`, bewildered indecision `ب ل د:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Stages organize change into a sequence, repetition brings a state back, and hesitation traps that recurrence between alternatives. Confusion is the participant's corresponding state when return no longer advances the process.

subchannels.name: Afterward, Interval, and Immediate Action
subchannels.scene_or_process: One event follows another, may recur after an interval, or occurs with no delay at all.
subchannels.active_motifs: subsequent time `ب ع د:B002/m01`, intermittent recurrence `ب ع د:B007/m01`, immediate enactment `ك ذ ب:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: `After` establishes ordinary succession, the intermittent construction inserts a gap before recurrence, and immediacy removes that gap. The three motifs define a compact scale from immediate action to delayed return.

subchannels.name: Uncut Continuity and Material Cessation
subchannels.scene_or_process: Duration persists when uncut, but exhaustion, failed yield, or wear severs an ongoing process.
subchannels.active_motifs: cutting or uninterrupted extension `م ن ن:B001/m01`, exhaustion that ends travel `م ن ن:B001/m02`, milk that does not persist `ك ذ ب:B006/m01`, cloth worn away through use `خ ل ق:B009/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Uncut extension names continuity positively through the absence of severance. Exhaustion, vanishing milk, and worn cloth provide three concrete ways in which motion, yield, and material presence reach an end.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Processes unfold through ordered stages, return in intervals, or terminate when their duration, material, or force is cut.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Temporal order spans stages of creation, hesitation, intermittent meetings, action without delay, repeated oiling, exhausted travel, failing milk, and fraying cloth.

parent_channels.name: Conflict, Reconciliation, and Civic Regulation

subchannels.name: Confrontation, Settlement, and Judgment
subchannels.scene_or_process: Opposing parties meet, reconcile their dispute, and submit the resulting settlement to judgment.
subchannels.active_motifs: confrontation and resistance `ق و م:B014/m01`, reconciliation between people `ص ل ح:B002/m01`, adjudication `ح ك م:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Confrontation supplies the opposed parties, reconciliation removes estrangement, and adjudication gives the agreement an authoritative form. The scene turns conflict into an ordered social relation rather than merely ending motion.

subchannels.name: Combat and the Truth of a Charge
subchannels.scene_or_process: Combatants resist one another with weapons, and a charge is judged by whether the attacker carries it through or falters.
subchannels.active_motifs: sword or staff combat `ب ل د:B011/m01`, resistance in combat `ق و م:B014/m01`, far-reaching hostility `ب ع د:B010/m01`, committed charge `ك ذ ب:B004/m01`, faltering charge `ك ذ ب:B004/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Hostility carries opposition into the encounter, armed combat gives it an instrument, and resistance holds the opponents against one another. The charge then tests resolve in motion: its truth is enacted by completion and its falsehood by stopping short.

subchannels.name: Office, Custom, and Civic Stewardship
subchannels.scene_or_process: An appointed official maintains a settled community through recurring office, customary order, and active stewardship.
subchannels.active_motifs: public appointment `ع م ل:B003/m01`, governance and stewardship `ق و م:B004/m02`, habitual order `د ي ن:B005/m01`, settled residence `ب ل د:B009/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Settlement supplies the governed setting, office assigns responsibility, custom stabilizes repeated conduct, and stewardship keeps the arrangement functioning over time.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Collective life regulates opposition through confrontation, negotiated settlement, adjudication, office, custom, and governance.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The peaceful and judicial frame extends into sword combat, wrestling resistance, the truth or failure of a charge, public office, habitual rule, and civic stewardship.

parent_channels.name: S1. Uncovered Roof and Open Exposure
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A roof or terrace rises within a place but lacks the parapet that would enclose its perimeter.
parent_channels.active_motifs: roof without a protective wall `ء ج ر:B003/m01`, bounded or open place `ب ل د:B001/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: The place supplies the spatial setting and the roof supplies elevation, while the missing enclosure makes exposure the scene's defining relation.

parent_channels.name: S2. Water-Holding Hollow and Well Apparatus
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Water gathers in a rock hollow or newly dug well and is served by a standing lifting component.
parent_channels.active_motifs: rock hollow or well that holds water `خ ل ق:B011/m01`, gathered water `ر د د:B007/m02`, standing pulley or well component `ق و م:B012/m03`
parent_channels.synthesis: The hollow provides containment, gathered water supplies the stored material, and the standing pulley component makes the reservoir accessible as a working well.
